title: Incident report INC-482
caption: The limit was cut from 100 to 50. The old values are struck through, not deleted.
verdict: The incident report says the Billing API limit was lowered from 100 to 50. The agent strikes through the old numbers on two pages instead of deleting them, adds the new ones, and records the incident and the lesson it teaches.
lesson: This is the step chunk RAG never takes. The March design doc still says 100 and 80; only the wiki now says those numbers are out of date.
